_comment: Transform language conformance vectors shared by C# (TransformConformanceTests) and Rust (bower-pipeline transform_vectors). Inputs are hand-written; expectations are generated by the C# implementation (set BOWER_TRANSFORM_VECTOR_OUTPUT) and reviewed.

assignment keeps position, new keys append
lower and upper are ASCII only

regex extract from an sshd message
